metadata.patch_name: Headline Character Limit Enforcement (≤90 chars) - HARDENED
metadata.author: User Requirement + Claude Hardening
refinements_applied: Executive summary now clarifies this closes ONE OF SEVERAL enforcement gaps
Staging buffer additions reduced to only consumed fields (removed char_count_no_spaces)
Enhanced edge case validation with explicit error messages
Added comparative validation to highlight other known gaps
Strengthened QA Report section with gap tracking

executive_summary: Closes ONE OF SEVERAL critical enforcement-validation gaps by enforcing K.4 headline character limit (≤90 chars) via new validation gate VG_HEADLINE_CHARACTER_COMPLIANCE. Reads from staging_buffer, blocks file writes on violation. Known remaining gaps: K.4 word count (≤4 per segment), K.5A bullet count (exactly 7), K.6A bullet count (exactly 6).

gap_context.description: This patch addresses the K.4 character limit gap within a broader set of identified enforcement-validation gaps
this_patch_closes: K.4 headline character limit enforcement (≤90 chars total)

known_remaining_gaps.description: K.4 headline word count per segment (≤4 words) not enforced

VG_HEADLINE_CHARACTER_COMPLIANCE.description: Validates K.4 headline character count ≤90. Reads from staging_buffer, cannot access artist_output.

on_fail.message: K.4 headline exceeds 90 character limit. Actual: {actual_chars} chars. Text: '{headline_text[:100]}...'

empty_headline.action: HALT_WITH_MESSAGE: 'K.4 headline is empty. Cannot generate resume with missing headline.'

whitespace_only.action: HALT_WITH_MESSAGE: 'K.4 headline contains only whitespace. Must contain substantive text.'

VG_HEADLINE_CHARACTER_COMPLIANCE.on_pass: Log '✅ VG_HEADLINE_CHARACTER_COMPLIANCE: K.4 headline is {actual_chars} chars (≤90)'

scope_verification.description: Verify gate reads from staging_buffer only
scope_verification.test: Try to access artist_output from within gate

changes.description: Update validation gate execution order to include headline check
changes.rationale: Placed after word count validation to maintain logical validation flow (word count → character count)

changes.description: Add headline character validation to QA Report Section 2 with gap tracking

enforcement_gap_tracker.format:
### Known K.4 Validation Gaps

⚠️ **Enforced in v1.6.7:**
- ✅ Character limit (≤90 chars total)

⚠️ **NOT YET ENFORCED (planned for v1.6.8+):**
- ⏳ Word count per segment (≤4 words)
- ⏳ Segment count validation

*Files may be generated with K.4 headlines that exceed per-segment word limits.*

changes.description: Update staging buffer to include character count for K.4 (LEAN VERSION - only consumed fields)
changes.rationale: Removed char_count_no_spaces from original patch as it is not consumed by any validation gate or QA section. Maintains lean implementation principle.

changes.description: Add critical rule for headline character limit
content: K.4 CHARACTER LIMIT (v1.6.7): Headline MUST be ≤90 characters total
K.4 VALIDATION (v1.6.7): VG_HEADLINE_CHARACTER_COMPLIANCE MUST validate K.4 character count
K.4 SCOPE ISOLATION (v1.6.7): Headline validation MUST read from staging_buffer ONLY
K.4 KNOWN GAPS (v1.6.7): Word count per segment NOT enforced until v1.6.8+

changes.description: Add headline character limit test suite

smoke_tests.name: Headline exactly 90 characters
smoke_tests.check: Generate headline with exactly 90 chars, verify passes

smoke_tests.name: Headline 91 characters
smoke_tests.check: Generate headline with 91 chars, verify fails

smoke_tests.name: Headline 89 characters
smoke_tests.check: Generate headline with 89 chars, verify passes

smoke_tests.name: Headline at 50 characters (well under limit)
smoke_tests.check: Generate headline with 50 chars, verify passes

edge_case_tests.name: Whitespace-only headline
edge_case_tests.check: Generate headline with only spaces, verify halts
edge_case_tests.expected: HALT with 'K.4 headline contains only whitespace'

edge_case_tests.name: Headline with trailing whitespace
edge_case_tests.check: Generate headline with trailing spaces, verify auto-stripped
edge_case_tests.expected: WARNING logged, whitespace stripped, validation proceeds

integration_tests.name: QA Report displays headline character count
integration_tests.check: Verify Section 2.1 shows actual character count
integration_tests.expected: Table row with K.4 char count

integration_tests.name: Headline regeneration on failure
integration_tests.check: Generate 100-char headline, verify regenerates up to 3 times
integration_tests.expected: Regeneration attempts logged, eventual pass or halt

integration_tests.name: File write blocked on headline violation
integration_tests.check: Generate 100-char headline, verify NO files written
integration_tests.expected: Zero output files, error report only

scope_isolation_tests.name: Validation reads from staging_buffer only
scope_isolation_tests.check: Corrupt artist_output K.4 metadata, verify validation unaffected
scope_isolation_tests.expected: Validation uses staging_buffer value (95), fails validation

4. Generate test headline with exactly 90 chars → verify passes
5. Generate test headline with 91 chars → verify fails (ValidationException)
6. Generate test headline with trailing whitespace → verify auto-stripped
7. Verify QA Report Section 2.1 displays character count AND gap tracker
8. Run HL-SCOPE-001 test (corrupt artist_output, verify staging_buffer used)
9. Run all 157 tests (147 existing + 10 new headline tests)
10. If all pass → Deploy to production
